g.text: Eight largest undarkened errors, retained in all primary metrics. Each patch: NEON-derived RGB left, actual Landsat RGB right; common 0-0.4 stretch.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Patches provide context, not causal labels. Full worst-pixel coordinates and diagnostic quantities are in failure_pixels.csv.
